sources.title: Denoising-and-4x-Super-Resolution-of-Low-Light-Images
sources.snippet: The pipeline is built around a pretrained Real-ESRGAN model (anime fine-tuned variant) for super-resolution, integrated with non-local means denoising from OpenCV to handle low-light noise artifacts before upscaling. The implementation is optimized for GPU acceleration and structured for batch inference on large image sets.
